summary: Coffee County, Alabama fire tower site, administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission per the register; only stands remain, next to a water tower. Access unknown.

facts.status_note: Register says stands are all that remain, found next to a water tower

events.note: Registered September 15, 2019 as US 1752, AL 23; nominated by Andrew Zerbe

evidence.supports: stands are all that remain, next to a water tower
evidence.quote: Stands are all that remain. Can be found next to water tower.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLOS register page. Two WebSearch queries found only a TopoQuest place entry (about 406 ft, search snippet only, not cited) and a Wikipedia article on the community that does not mention a lookout in the fetched portion. The Eastern lookouts (weebly) Alabama index has no Damascus page (404). No build, removal, staffing, fire or access dates were found, so events are limited to the 2019 registration. Access is left unstated because no source says whether the site is public.
